description: Range-trader operational hardening: fix verifier for WETH-quoted positions, add log monitor with Telegram alerts, fold range-trader into the daily email report, and update PROJ doc.

stories.title: Fix range_verifier.py for WETH-quoted positions
stories.description: range_verifier.py was written when ZEN/USDC was the assumed quote. ZEN (and VFY, ZRO) actually trade against WETH on Aerodrome Slipstream. The verifier uses get_price() which returns price_usd from the Nansen screener -- that is still correct for USD P&L. The bug is that position fields may store entry_usdc but the wallet holds WETH, not USDC. Fix: (1) add a get_weth_balance() helper that reads the METAMASK wallet's WETH balance (0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006, 18 decimals). (2) In verify(), after checking all token positions, also check that total WETH + ETH (native) >= 0.005 ETH for gas -- alert if below. (3) Change the Telegram alert prefix from plain text to include [RANGE] tag so it is distinguishable from base-trader alerts. (4) Ensure the script handles the case where positions list is empty gracefully (already does, keep it). File: businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_verifier.py. Use the existing ERC20_ABI, web3 pattern, and send_telegram() already in the file -- do not change the overall structure, just apply the 3 targeted fixes above.

stories.title: Create range_log_monitor.py
stories.description: Create businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_log_monitor.py modelled exactly on businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/log_monitor.py but for the range-trader data directory. Checks: (1) Pipeline heartbeat: last entry in data/range_run_log.jsonl within 35 min -- alert if stale or missing. (2) Error scan: check data/range-trader-err.log (the launchd stderr log at businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/data/range-trader-err.log) for Traceback, Error:, CRITICAL, Exception in last 150 lines. (3) Verifier alarms: entries in data/range_verifier_log.jsonl with status='fail' or status='warn' in last 2 hours. (4) WETH gas floor: read METAMASK wallet ETH balance via web3 RPC https://mainnet.base.org -- alert if below 0.01 ETH. METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS env var. Send ONE consolidated Telegram message if any check fails. Silent if all pass. Message prefix: [RANGE MONITOR]. send_telegram() uses TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS env vars (same pattern as log_monitor.py). DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'data'. Load env from Path.home() / '.openclaw' / '.env'. No credit budget check needed (range-trader shares credit_log.jsonl with base-trader which already monitors it). Add shebang line. Make file executable with chmod.

stories.title: Add range-trader launchd plist for log monitor
stories.description: Create /Users/jill/Library/LaunchAgents/com.crestview.range-log-monitor.plist to run range_log_monitor.py every 2 hours (7200 seconds). Pattern from /Users/jill/Library/LaunchAgents/com.crestview.base-trader-log-monitor.plist. Key fields: Label=com.crestview.range-log-monitor, ProgramArguments=[/usr/bin/python3, /Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_log_monitor.py], StartInterval=7200, RunAtLoad=false, StandardOutPath=/Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/data/range-log-monitor.log (absolute path), StandardErrorPath=/Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/data/range-log-monitor-err.log (absolute path). EnvironmentVariables dict must include PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin. After writing, run: launchctl load /Users/jill/Library/LaunchAgents/com.crestview.range-log-monitor.plist

stories.title: Add range-trader section to daily_summary.py
stories.description:
Extend businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/daily_summary.py to include a RANGE TRADER section in the report. Add a new function get_range_summary() that: (1) Reads range_positions.json from businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/data/range_positions.json -- list of position dicts with keys symbol, address, entry_price, stop_loss, tokens_held, entry_usdc. (2) For each open position fetches current price_usd from Nansen screener (reuse existing get_current_price() function already in daily_summary.py). (3) Computes current_usd = tokens_held * price, pnl_pct = (price - entry_price) / entry_price * 100. (4) Reads last entry from businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/data/range_run_log.jsonl for last run timestamp. (5) Reads METAMASK wallet ETH + WETH balance via web3 (METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS env var, same RPC). WETH address: 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006. (6) Returns a markdown string block. Then call get_range_summary() inside generate_report() and append the block to the report lines. The block should look like:
## RANGE TRADER
**Last run:** <ts>
**METAMASK wallet:** <eth> ETH + <weth> WETH
**Open positions:** N
| Symbol | Entry | Current | PnL | Stop |
|--------|-------|---------|-----|------|
| ZEN | $6.23 | $6.31 | +1.3% | $5.04 |
(No positions open) if list empty.
